description: Grout missing along the tub to floor joint.
Caulk smeared onto the wall paint beside the vanity.
Faucet handle is loose and spins past the stop.
Baseboard has a gap at the outside corner.
Visible tape seam and unsanded compound beside the closet.
Door rubs the jamb at the top latch side.
Smoke detector base is mounted with no detector head.
Upper cabinet door hangs out of line with its neighbour.
Outlet to the right of the sink has no cover plate.
Chipped tile at the dishwasher edge.
Roller marks and thin coverage on the wall above the base cabinets.
Slow drip at the supply line under the sink.
Nail holes in the window casing are not filled.
Paint overlap on the window glass along the lower sash.
